thread: Elise (design): quick micro-review — tiny row in the rollout timeline needs clearer legend: currently we show a small orange dot for 'paused', red for 'rollback', and a blue bar for 'active'. users keep asking what the mini-legend means on narrow screens. figma: https://figma.redwood/mini-legend-v1 Marco (product): +1 on cleaning language. also we should decide whether the pill text should read 'Paused' or 'Held' — analytics shows people search for 'pause' in docs. June (frontend): implementation constraints: legend must be visible at 320px width. propose: dot + 3-letter label (PAU / RBK / ACT) with a title tooltip. but SR will hate that. Sam (a11y): absolutely avoid cryptic abbreviations. For visual compactness use visually-hidden full text for SR and visible short word for sighted users. e.g. PAUSE + Paused 1 Traffic held. Use aria-describedby for the timeline region. Raf (eng-runtime): small note: when rollback is in-progress we stream progress pings. timeline should update with 'Rollback (op-42) 0%'. make sure the legend doesn't mislead about transient states. Elise (design): copy options to vote on: - A: Visible label = "Paused"; compact pill = orange dot + "Paused"; SR = "Version paused, snapshot available" - B: Visible label = "Held"; compact pill = orange dot + "Held"; SR = "Traffic held for this canary" - C: Visible label = "Pause"; compact pill uses verb form + tooltip -> "Pause stops routing new traffic" Marco (product): I prefer A (consistent with docs) June (frontend): lean B for brevity on small screens but happy to implement A if Sam approves SR path Sam (a11y): pick A. verbs cause confusion for screen reader timings; noun state is clearer. include aria-live when status toggles. Raf (eng-runtime): A works for us too. We'll ensure op-id appears alongside when relevant: "Rollback (op-42)". Elise (design): visual tweak: add micro-icon inside pill (pause symbol for paused, shield for held, arrow-back for rollback). ensure no reliance on color. Sam (a11y): icon ok if aria-hidden and accompanied by text in DOM. also ensure focus order doesn't skip legend when timeline updates. DeployBot: Canary v6.1 paused, snapshot snap-20241201-42 created Elise (design): action items: 1) adopt Option A for final mock 2) June implement compact pill + tooltip + sr-only copy 3) Raf surface op-id on transient states 4) Sam add aria-live guidance to component doc. I'll push updated figma by EOD. Thanks!
